Results.ReviewText: I was pleasantly surprised by this grill. We are downsizing and needed a smaller grill. This little grill cooks just as well as my full sized Weber Genesis II 300 series. Since I am only cooking for two of us now, capacity is not an issue. I also like the portability. I can put it in the trunk and take it to the park or beach. I also bought the folding stand. The stand itself is a bit on the flimsy side but it's nice for use on the deck and I can fold everything down and roll it away in the corner when not in use. The only downside is that I go through the 1lb gas bottles after only a handful of cooks. I am going to purchase the 20# tank adapter hose for home use and save the bottles for portability.

Results.ReviewText: The grill itself was awesome for camping and portable use. It got hot and was easy to clean. Unfortunately the grill stopped igniting after just over 2 years of use. The issue with this is the grill has only been used about 10 times. Upon investigation it seems to be a common problem with the gas valve/regulator. It is a very expensive part considering the price of the grill, roughly ~$80. When I reached out to customer service to explained the issue and ask for a replacement part. They asked me to elaborate on the issue which made no sense because I had already explained the issue in a previous message. Regardless I did and then was ghosted. Pretty frustrated by the situation. And now I’m left with the options of buying the part myself or just opting to buy a cheaper charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Great grill with poor quality regulator

Results.ReviewText: Prior to getting the weber Q 1200 grill, I had never used a propane grill. I was frustrated by the amount of time needed to grill over charcoal for just two of us. I really wondered if this small frill would be a good decision. Well, it has proven to be very good! The grill is plenty big enough, very easy to use, light in weight but more than sturdy. I have it located on a stainless steel table that we already had on the back porch. Our dinner literally goes from raised vegetable garden to grill to patio table (plus protein on grill, too)I purchased the accessories of tubing to attach a large propane tank (rather than a canister) and a grill basket for veggies—all from Weber. A friend helped me assemble the grill only because I thought I couldn’t, however she did not have any experience doing this either and we were done in less than 10 minutes! I am very happy with this purchase and like some reviews I read before buying, my only regret is that I had not done it sooner!

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We suggest using disposable LP cylinders with a capacity of either 14.1 oz. or 16.4 oz. equipped with a CGA #600 connection.

To install the LP cylinder properly, you want to start by making sure the burner control knob is turned off, by pushing it in and turning it clockwise to the off position.

While holding the carrying handle closest to the propane cylinder with one hand, push the propane cylinder into the regulator and turn clockwise until tight.

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.

ClientResponses.Response:
We are sorry to hear that your grill isn't reaching the proper temperature. Your grill should be able to reach the same high temperature we expect from all of our grills, at least 450 F. 

If your grill is not getting that hot, we would suggest starting by double-checking your current gas pressure. The gas pressure provided to the grill is of the utmost importance, it affects the performance of the burner tube(s).

Please lookout for an email from our Support team, we would like to hear more about this experience.
